thread:
matteo: Heads up — courier dropped a long flat tube in the lobby with a label that just says ‘poster — ACME demo’. No recipient name. It’s on Shelf B in the package room.
anya: Thanks — I can swing by in 10. Could be from marketing, they ordered prints last week.
frontdesk-bot: Package logged: P-4722. Placed on Shelf B. Notified #people-ops.
matteo: @leila can you confirm? If it’s for marketing we should tag and drop it on the design desk, otherwise keep in packages.
leila: I did a quick slack search — nothing obvious. @samir are you expecting large prints for the booth?
samir: Not from me. But quick reminder — we have a visiting partner at 3pm (Jordan) and would love to reserve the window table + one visitor badge ready.
jordan: arriving ~3:05, will be with a portfolio bag. Happy to sit at the window table, thanks!
anya: @frontdesk-bot can you pre-create a visitor badge with 'Partner — Jordan' and print it? Also tag it to the package P-4722 in case it’s related.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor badge created: VB-319 (label: Partner, name: Jordan). Will print on arrival. P-4722 linked to visitor record.
matteo: If nobody claims the poster by EOD, can we ship it back to sender? It looks fragile so please mark fragile in the log.
leila: Will mark fragile and add a quick photo to the package log.
matteo: photo: https://img.company.internal/packages/1719876543-poster.jpg
anya: Nice — looks like a booth backdrop. Tagging #marketing so they see it.
samir: Quick poll — where should Jordan sit while they chat with the PMs? React with :one: for window table, :two: for small conf table, :three: for lounge couch.
jordan: I’ll take whatever — window sounds great though.
matteo: :one: from me.
leila: :two: (I vote conf if we expect print layout work)
anya: :one: (window)
frontdesk-bot: Reaction summary: :one: 2, :two: 1, :three: 0
matteo: OK window table it is. Thanks everyone. Will leave P-4722 on Shelf B until marketing or sender confirm. :thumbsup:
anya: Thanks! I’ll ping marketing now.
leila: @marketing-team — FYI poster in lobby, P-4722."
